demand_drivers.body:
- There is growing demand for Calcium Hypochlorite in the international market.
- Most of the raw materials are easily available locally, giving savings in transportation costs.
- The Company surpassed its previous year performance in Stable Bleaching Powder (SBP), Sodium Hydride, Sulphuric Acid, and power generation through wind and solar.
- There was a decline in performance in Calcium Hypochlorite (HSH) and Sodium Methoxide.
